evals.prompt: What is this post on? "Priya Shah, Head of Growth. Our free trial converted at 4%. We added a 10-minute onboarding call for every trial user. Conversion went to 11%. The onboarding call did more than any feature we shipped this year. If you run a free trial, book the onboarding call. #SaaS #growth"
evals.expected_output: A single line: onboarding call. The phrase reuses the author's repeated term, starts lowercase, has no punctuation, quotes, or hashtags, and fits 'Priya's post on onboarding call'.
assertions: Output is one line with one to three words
Uses the author's repeated term 'onboarding call' or a close literal variant
No ending punctuation, quotation marks, hashtags, or emojis
Gives no reasoning because none was asked for

evals.prompt:
Tag these three posts for my outreach list:
1. "Hot take: your pricing page is a sales page. We cut ours from four tiers to two and demo requests went up 30%."
2. "Hiring update: we're looking for a founding designer. DM me."
3. "Nobody reads your case studies. We turned ours into 60-second customer videos and they now get shared in every deal."
evals.expected_output: Three numbered lines in the input order, each one to three words drawn from the post: for example 1. pricing page, 2. founding designer, 3. customer videos (or case studies).
assertions: Returns exactly three lines, numbered 1 to 3, in the input order
Each phrase is one to three words
Post 1 is tagged with pricing page or a close literal variant
Post 2 is tagged with founding designer or hiring a designer
Each phrase reads naturally in '{author}'s post on {phrase}'
No hashtags, quotes, or ending punctuation

evals.prompt: Distil this: "Are you ready for 2027? Big things coming. Follow for more. Link in comments."
evals.expected_output: Says in one line that the post has no clear topic beyond promotion and asks for the full text or accepts a cautious generalised label if the user insists. Does not invent a topic the post does not contain.
assertions: Does not invent a specific topic that is absent from the post
Flags in one line that the post has no clear topic
Contains no em dashes or exclamation marks
